sentences.text: No DATE ORDER NOTE 17 05.11.2024 CGR, J Heard Sri N.Siva Reddy, learned counsel for petitioners.

He would submit that in view of Section 24(2) of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabiliation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as no award has been passed, the initiation of land acquisition proceedings including Section 6 declaration made under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
would lapse.

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Government Pleader seeks time to seek instructions in this regard and also to ascertain the stage of land acquisition proceedings including the necessity of the requirement under the impugned notification.
